snippet.title: Law School - Season 1 Official trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Law School on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3369070/Law_School__Season_1/

Welcome to Stocklinburg Law College!

Step into the prestigious halls of one of America's top law schools, where a young man’s dream of becoming the best lawyer in the country begins.

Law School is a 3D adult visual novel where your choices shape relationships, rivalries, and a gripping narrative. Experience drama, humor, romance, mini-games, and a fully interactive social app as you follow the journey of a first-year law student at Stocklinburg College.
